PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-53349  Recommendation to receive and file President’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-53358  Recommendation to approve the minutes for The Long Beach Community
  Investment Company meeting of Wednesday, April 17, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-53372  Recommendation to adopt the Long Beach Community Investment Company
  proposed Fiscal Year 2024-2025 (FY 25) budget.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-53374  Recommendation to authorize the President or designee to amend and restate the
  Disposition and Development Agreement, Regulatory Agreement, Promissory Note
  and Deed of Trust with Grisham Community Housing, LP for a 96-unit affordable
  housing development at 11 West 49th Street; and

  Authorize the President or designee to execute any and all documents necessary to
  implement the amendment.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
